title: xo work connection policy (~/.quirq/work/inbox/<connection>/connection.json)
description: What a connection folder does with what its poller collects (docs/work-and-workitems.md section 17.4): which collectors become items, whether and when a session starts, what a session may do. Written by services/work/items.py and hand-editable; a value out of range falls back to its safe default on read.

items.description: collector id -> whether its events become items

kinds.description: auto: the collectors whose items start a session on arrival

act.description: may a session act on the connection (send, label)?
